evidence:
The frozen workbook row 23 requires launch assumptions to be disclosed, and the applicable internal annotation concerns the identity-surface convention; it creates no extra same-origin requirement. In the frozen task, instruction.md:9-11 discloses /app/server.js, node startup, PORT/3000, /api/health without database work, a single UI/API process, DB_PATH and /app/app.db, copying seed assets, and durable idempotent startup. integration.md:3-10 specifies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH, 0.0.0.0 and health before database work; :16-19 states exactly the symlink restriction enforced by test.sh:72-83. hireops_rules.md:414-419 explicitly discloses a different working directory, an unprivileged user, a writable application copy, module-relative or absolute asset paths, all five injected environment variables, and HOME pointing to the writable copy. These match test.sh:97-111 and its restart launch :160-167; the readiness URLs in :48 and :136 include the stated health endpoint. Agent Dockerfile:9-11 and tests/Dockerfile:20-21 provide identical Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 dependencies; both use Node 22. Public network/browser CDN use is allowed in instruction.md:9 and task.toml:22,38, with no same-origin test in test.sh. The current test.sh and both Dockerfiles were byte-compared to their frozen template counterparts and are identical.

Hash verification: raw-evidence-index.json SHA256 44a021e35f91308c5a0ac4a377682a94aeb37b49f8280bec70eeb52ef5f6a287, matching assigned input_sha256; all 150 indexed files matched their recorded SHA256. local/install-lifecycle/results.json SHA256 52b5ba96bded2e133fe4ec16117c150d46673f70ce31284169193f478c73e9f9 contains a successful fresh install and actual process replacement (PID 21 to 97) with saved-record readback; its solution_app_sha256 map matches every corresponding frozen reference file. Its driver, SHA256 05780ac5eb6f1e441ef5a946a36f466ad7cdee7ae239b5f7d7d9f5933f39e024, explicitly launches env -i, UID 65534, and cwd=/tests and checks sign-in plus durable record readback. The restart log SHA256 8119471c3dc97075e3f9484758c92fee895d052a9bf0eef6ad3929d86e6fd5e0 records ready=1. This is supporting finite runtime evidence, not an end-to-end configured judge measurement: the lifecycle driver uses HOME=/app and does not exercise the copy fallback or full test.sh. The contract comparison itself is complete for row 23; no Oracle/model/portal score or private deterministic-suite execution is claimed.
counterexample: Broken-app attempt: a server returning only a health response could satisfy test.sh readiness, which accepts reachable HTTP even on an error, but the render gate (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23) explicitly rejects a health-only/static app and requires invalid-password refusal followed by successful sign-in and a substantive workspace. No row-23 false pass follows from readiness alone. Conforming-alternative attempt: use Express static files relative to cwd, pass the agent image /app startup, and fail the verifier /tests startup; this is not conforming because hireops_rules.md:414-417 explicitly forbids assuming cwd=/app. A genuinely conforming alternative that resolves UI/seed files relative to its module and honors DB_PATH remains valid under both normal and writable-copy launch. No undisclosed launch requirement was found.
